mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 1.5% compresses equity discount rates through lower risk-free rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as valuation multiples expand.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 1.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in federal funds rate above 2.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of triggered periods, or Rank IC > -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous acceleration in real GDP growth (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates robust consumer demand and construction activity, driving corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The GDPC1-HOUST interaction term is insignificant (p>0.05) in 20d return regressions, or Rank IC for the interaction signal < 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.5%), labor market tightness reduces corporate labor costs and boosts profit margins, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 4.5%, or regime-specific Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in unemployment rate above 5.0% signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of triggered periods, or Rank IC > -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained industrial production level above 100 (2017=100) indicates expanding manufacturing capacity utilization, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO > 100, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in real consumer spending (RSAFS) below 460,000 million dollars signals weakening household consumption, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of triggered periods, or Rank IC > -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained non-farm payrolls increase above 146,000 thousand persons indicates strong labor market growth that boosts consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS > 146000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
